events.name: Persian and Arabic lexical contact in Bengal
events.locator: Section 1.2, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 31), paragraph beginning with the thirteenth-century invasion of Bengal.

dating.label: Context following the 13th century; no end supplied

events.note: Thompson connects Arabic and Persian borrowing in Bengal with Persian court use following thirteenth-century conquest. Catalogue participants identify broad language lineages, not exact historical varieties. The open end does not date individual loans or assert uninterrupted contact. No geographic endpoints or route are supplied.
